overview_description.description: Mistral AI develops artificial intelligence models, applications, and infrastructure for organizations and developers. Its product portfolio includes Vibe for autonomous work and coding, Studio for building and deploying AI applications, Forge for training and customizing models, and Compute for AI training and inference infrastructure. The company also provides frontier models, APIs, model customization, document intelligence, speech solutions, and applied AI services for business and public-sector use cases. Its deployment options include self-hosted environments, Mistral-hosted services, and integrations through cloud providers. Mistral AI supports applications such as enterprise knowledge search, data analysis, document synthesis, coding, agent orchestration, model evaluation, and domain-specific AI development.

about_short_description.short_description: Mistral AI develops artificial intelligence models, applications, and infrastructure for organizations and developers.

product.name: Frontier AI Models
product.description: A portfolio of language, multimodal, speech, and document-processing models available through APIs, cloud platforms, or self-hosted deployments.

product.name: Studio
product.description: An enterprise platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and monitoring AI applications and agents across cloud, edge, and on-premises environments.

product.name: Forge
product.description: A platform for training, aligning, evaluating, and managing custom AI models adapted to an organization’s proprietary data and domain requirements.

product.name: Vibe
product.description: An AI agent for long-horizon work that uses organizational knowledge and connected tools to perform multi-step tasks.

product.name: Vibe for Code
product.description: A coding-agent product for terminal, IDE, and background workflows, supporting code generation, maintenance, testing, and software delivery.

product.name: Compute
product.description: Infrastructure and orchestration for large-scale AI model training and inference, including dedicated GPU clusters and supporting research capabilities.
